text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe on Monday urged the Southern African Development Community to work towards a tariff regime which will see member countries enjoying zero percent tariffs within the next few years.
- The Private Business Corporations Act which provides an easy and inexpensive mechanism for small businesses to create a legally binding body with corporate status came into effect on Monday.

- Zimbabwe's Law and Order (Maintanance) Act is to be repealed -- if parliament agrees -- and replaced with the Public Order and Security Act which stresses the rights of the public to engage in lawful political activity and public gatherings that do not interfere with the rights of others.
